title: עוגיות שושנה
notes: The word 'עוגיות' is drawn inside a box at the top; 'שושנה' is written beside it. A bordered zig-zag decoration runs along the bottom of the card.

The left column is fenced off by a slanted line and a bottom line; its purpose is unclear (a second reading by another model interprets it as an oil-based alternative to the dough, but this could not be confirmed).
'קנמון' is spelled without yod on the card.
A short dash after '1 כוס סוכר' is treated as a line filler.

Independent Codex rereading of the full scan and enlarged crops: אפשר להוסיף, וקוקוס, או שקית, ולחתוך לריבועים, and ולאפות are visually confirmed. The loop at the left of להוסיף belongs to the handwriting; it is not treated as an ingredient quantity 8. Ambiguous optional additions remain flagged.
Owner (chat, 2026-10-06): confirmed the source of this card as recorded.
Owner (issue #427): the left box reads 'אפשר להוסיף / קליפת לימון / טיפות וניל / וקוקוס, או שקדים / 3 1/2 כוסות קמח'; the first method line is 'לערבב טוב, משטחת בתבנית'.
